source_freeze.committed: Export exact selected full commit with git archive --mtime=1970-01-01T00:00:00Z --format=tar; never archive the live directory.

source_freeze.tree_manifest: git ls-tree -rz --full-tree TREE; record mode,blob ID,path and contentSHA256. Current tracked source has no .gitattributes, symlinks or submodules; require exported archive to match every Git blob to catch export-ignore/export-subst or omission.
source_freeze.transfer: Hash source.tar and source manifest locally; scp only these frozen artifacts to a fresh directory; check sha256sum remotely before extracting into source/. Keep receipt/control files outside source/.
source_freeze.post_run: Recompare every frozen tracked source hash and Git executable mode after lake update and after all runs. Changes to lake-manifest.json or any proof/config/script invalidate this source replay. Generated .lake content is excluded from source identity.
source_freeze.exact_transfer_commands:
STAFFORD_REMOTE_STAGE=$(ssh -o BatchMode=yes mailuefterl 'mktemp -d /mnt/storage/stafford38-final-replay-20261002.XXXXXX')
scp -o BatchMode=yes "$STAFFORD_SNAPSHOT/source.tar" "$STAFFORD_SNAPSHOT/source-manifest.json" "mailuefterl:$STAFFORD_REMOTE_STAGE/"

process_tracking.launch: Use one fresh stage and detached setsid/nohup driver only after controller start. Record pid,process-group,/proc/PID/stat start ticks, exact command line,source tree/patch hashes and log path. Driver trap writes atomic terminal exit record.
process_tracking.timeouts: GNU timeout --kill-after=60s 19800s per local heavy command; retain stage exit code. Exit124 proves local capacity exhaustion, not a proof failure. Official workflow has350minute job/19800second total budget.
process_tracking.poll: Every30-60seconds check same recorded live PID plus start ticks and command line; inspect bounded log tail and terminal exit record. Observation/SSH timeout is not terminal. Never restart solely because observation expired; missing process without exit record requires logs and termination evidence.
process_tracking.success: Every required stage exit0, no missing axiom/import/dependency reports, actual kernel acceptance markers present, source fingerprint unchanged; then retain receipt and compressed logs.
process_tracking.exact_launch:
scp -o BatchMode=yes /tmp/stafford38-linux-driver-20261002.sh "mailuefterl:$STAFFORD_REMOTE_STAGE/driver.sh"
ssh -o BatchMode=yes mailuefterl bash -s -- "$STAFFORD_REMOTE_STAGE" <<'REMOTE'
set -euo pipefail
cd "$1"
nohup setsid bash driver.sh "$1/source" "$1/receipts" >"$1/receipts/driver.log" 2>&1 </dev/null &
pid=$!
printf '%s\n' "$pid" >receipts/driver.pid
python3 - "$pid" "$1/receipts/process-handle.json" <<'PYHANDLE'
import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
pid=int(sys.argv[1]); proc=Path('/proc')/str(pid)
stat=proc.joinpath('stat').read_text().rpartition(') ')[2].split()
record={'pid':pid,'process_group':int(stat[2]),'start_ticks':int(stat[19]),'command_line':proc.joinpath('cmdline').read_bytes().replace(b'\0',b' ').decode()}
Path(sys.argv[2]).write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(record))
PYHANDLE
REMOTE
